newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank cuts lending rate 25 bsp.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank cuts lending rate 25 bsp.

text.p: Bangkok Bank Plc said on Tuesday it cut its Minimum Lending Rate (MLR) 25 basis points to 12.75 percent, effective May 28.
A Bangkok Bank official said the bank, the biggest in Thailand, also reduced its fixed deposit rates by the same margin, which would leave its lowest 12-month fixed deposit rate at 8.00 percent.
The official said Bangkok Bank did not change its current Minimum Overdraft Rate (MOR) of 13.25 percent.
Major Thai banks have started cutting prime lending rates since Monday in response to a decision by the central bank to adjust guidelines for commercial banks to calculate their retail lending rates.
The central bank said banks would have more flexibility in fixing retail lending rates, which can float up to four percentage points above their MLRs.
The central bank said it hoped the new guidelines would induce private banks to cut lending rates in order to spur Thailand's sluggish economy.
